title: Task
description: What an orchestrator hands to an agent.

id.description: Stable id of this task within a run.

goal.description: The outcome wanted, in one or two sentences.

context.description: Background the agent cannot discover by reading the code.

files.description: Paths or globs the agent owns for this task.

constraints.description: Things the agent must not do.

inputs.description: Outputs of earlier steps, keyed by step id.
